source: THE WAR TEASER (pipeline number 96; never a numbered episode). About a minute: why the war happens, the principal figures introduced one at a time, the conches, the chariot between the armies, the universal form. Every beat read in the constituted text of the BORI Critical Edition (GRETIL, lab/ce/): script/TEASER-CHECK.md. In short: 1.107.1, 5.125.26, 1.2.234 and 6.23.1, 5.153.26 and 1.94.86-90, 1.122.39-40 and 1.2.26, 1.104.11 and 5.165.27, 5.7.17-20 and 5.7.35, 6.23.12-20, 6.23.20-26 and 6.23.47, 6.33.9-32.
structure: TITLE over the 3D field (sound on frame 0) -> WHY: the throne, the refusal -> THE FIELD (3D) -> SIX INTRODUCTIONS, slow, one at a time (Duryodhana in the refusal; Bhishma, Drona, Karna; Arjuna, Krishna) -> a rest (a dip) -> THE WAR RUN: conches, arrows, the chariot between the armies, the bow lowered -> THE PEAK: the universal form, "I am Time" -> the promise -> the end card.

loop.hookQuestion: Why do two armies of one family meet at Kurukshetra?

strings.sourceLine: Text: the Mahabharata · BORI Critical Edition

lines.note: OPENING, no voice; SOUND ON THE FIRST FRAME (a sub hit, a war drum and the conch). 3D: Kurukshetra at dawn, the camera low over massed ranks pushing in toward the red sun, banners moving, dust drifting through the lens. MAHABHARATAM arrives large, legible by 1.5 s; AS VYASA TOLD IT under it.

lines.text: A hundred brothers. Five cousins. One throne.
lines.note: CE 1.107.1 (the hundred), the five sons of Pandu: drawn. The hall: an empty lion-throne lit from above; a hundred small figures in purple on the left, five in white on the right; the focus racks from the hundred to the five to the throne on the words.

lines.text: Duryodhana will not give a needle-point of earth.
lines.note: CE 5.125.26: a slow push-in to the closest face of the film: Duryodhana, crowned, the mace upright. Plaque DURYODHANA. A needle glints and turns at the edge of the frame.

CE 1.2.234 (eighteen akshauhinis; the war lasted eighteen days), 6.23.1 (dharmakshetre kurukshetre). 3D WIDE: the camera cranes up and back from the ground over the plain; two dark seas of ranks with banners, chariots rolling into line, dust over the field. The first big 3D reveal.

lines.text: Bhishma, the grandsire, leads the Kauravas.
lines.note: CE 5.153.26 (Duryodhana makes Bhishma commander), 1.94.86-90 (the vow). Drawn Bhishma, white and silver, the great bow, in front of 3D ranks with silver banners; a slow push-in. Plaque BHISHMA · the grandsire, sworn never to rule.

lines.text: Drona taught them all. Now he fights for Duryodhana.
lines.note: CE 1.122.39-40 (Bhishma gives Pandu's sons and the Kauravas to Drona as pupils), 1.2.26 (Drona guards the Kuru host five days). Drawn Drona (new kit figure: an old brahmin warrior, saffron, grey top-knot, bow) beside a 3D row of chariots; the camera slides with him. Plaque DRONA · teacher of both sides.

lines.text: Karna will not fight while Bhishma lives.
lines.note: CE 5.165.27 (he will not fight while Bhishma lives); the plaque: born in armour, 1.104.11. Drawn Karna, sun-gold armour and the glowing earrings, against a 3D low sun; he sets his bow down. Plaque KARNA · born in armour, the Sun's son.

lines.text: Arjuna, the archer, chose Krishna over an army.
lines.note: CE 5.7.19-20 (Arjuna chooses Keshava, who will not fight; Duryodhana takes the army). Drawn Arjuna with the bow (Gandiva is not named); behind him, out of focus, the 3D army that Duryodhana took. Plaque ARJUNA · the archer of the five.

lines.text: Krishna will lift no weapon. He drives the chariot.
lines.note: CE 5.7.17 (ayudhyamanah ... nyastashastro: not fighting, weapons laid down), 5.7.35 (I will be your charioteer), 6.23.14 (white horses yoked to the great chariot). 3D chariot with four white horses and turning wheels; drawn Krishna on it at the reins, in colour, his face in shadow (kept for the form). Plaque KRISHNA · of the Vrishnis, the charioteer.

lines.text: The conches sound. The first arrows fly.
lines.note: THE TURN (CE 6.23.12-19: Bhishma's conch, then the conches, drums and horns of both sides; 6.23.20 pravritte shastrasampate: the weapons had begun to fly). A REST BEFORE IT, NOT A SILENCE: the bed dips 3.5 dB and a riser climbs. 3D: both armies; conch shockwaves ring out across the plain; banners whip; then the first volley rises with trails and arcs over the camera. The war run starts here: the cutting is faster from now on.

lines.text: Arjuna asks for his chariot between the armies.
lines.note: CE 6.23.20-24 (the monkey banner; set my chariot between the two armies; Krishna sets it there). 3D: the white horses at the gallop, wheels turning, the monkey banner, the chariot running out between the two armies with arrows crossing high overhead; drawn Arjuna and Krishna on it (placed by the 3D projection).

lines.text: He sees teachers and kin. He lowers his bow.
lines.note: CE 6.23.25-26 (before Bhishma and Drona: he sees fathers, grandfathers, teachers, uncles, brothers, sons), 6.23.47 (he sits on the chariot floor, letting go of bow and arrows). A push-in on Arjuna as the bow leaves his hand; the 3D armies behind him out of focus (depth of field), dust drifting.

lines.text: Krishna shows his supreme form. “I am Time.”
lines.note: THE SIGNATURE SHOT AND THE ONE LONG HOLD (CE 6.33.9 paramam rupam aishvaram; 6.33.12 the light of a thousand suns; 6.33.19, 25 mouths of blazing fire; 6.33.26-29 both armies, Bhishma, Drona and Karna among them, streaming in like moths into a flame; 6.33.32 kalo 'smi). A SUB DROP INTO THE SHOT. 3D divine light: a white core, glowing tubes of light, a shockwave across the plain, particle streams; the drawn form (many faces, many arms) above Arjuna; the camera pulls back from him.

lines.text: Taken from the Critical Edition, the text scholars read. Nothing added for effect.
lines.note: The series' promise, worded to be true (TEASER-CHECK.md, "The promise"). Palm leaves with lines of Sanskrit-like strokes (not letters) and, as they pass, the references of the verses this teaser used. After the peak the sound comes down to the drone and the motif.

THE END CARD, held and always moving: MAHABHARATAM large, FOLLOW in a ring that beats, "Episode 1 · The Storyteller Arrives", the source line ONLY. ONE STRUCK RESOLVE on the cut; it rings under the card.
